# capabilities

The watch block's mandate capabilities as plain data — `watch.children` (an
agent watches the tasks it files) and `watch.tree` (the agent on the mandate's
root task watches the whole tree). A leaf: `watch` imports `conversations`
(to deliver turns), and `conversations` reaches `mandate-presets`, which
grants these, so they cannot live in `watch/core`. Their describe text and
behaviour stay in `watch/machine`.

## Plugin reference

- Description: The watch.children and watch.tree mandate capabilities as plain data. A leaf, so a mandate author (mandate-presets, reached from conversations) can grant them without a cycle through watch, which imports conversations.
- Core:
  - Uses: `tasks/orchestration/mandate/policy.defineCapability`
  - Exports (values):
    - `watchChildren`
    - `watchTree`
